Container.Name: RISTWatch
Container.Overview: RISTWatch 0.5.0 build 10. Live RIST ingest monitor and relay. Set the optional username/password variables here, or edit /mnt/user/appdata/ristwatch/config.yaml under rist_auth. Docker variables override config.yaml values.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent RISTWatch configuration, logs, and database.

Config.Name: RIST Enabled
Config.Description: Start the real ristreceiver listener on the Test RIST port.

Config.Name: RIST Username (optional override)
Config.Description: Optional override for rist_auth.username in /config/config.yaml. Leave blank to use the config file.

Config.Name: RIST Password (optional override)
Config.Description: Optional masked override for rist_auth.password in /config/config.yaml. Leave blank to use the config file.
